items.label: Lightly
items.text: Narration prose will swear Lightly: Light profanity only. Damn and hell equivalents only.

items.label: Natural
items.text: Narrator will swear Naturally: Swear as much as the situation warrant. Explicit swears (fuck, shit, cunt, etc.) are allowed.

items.label: Heavy
items.text: Narration prose will swear Heavily: Profanity is normal part of speech and narration (fuck, shit, damn, etc.), frequent and strong. Use other swears from vocabulary

items.label: Setting Appropiate
items.text: Narrator can swear Setting Appropriately: Profanity is based on setting, period, fantasy. Modern settings use modern profanity, medieval setting uses medieval profanity, etc.
